purpose: Improve Dashboard V2 first-screen K-line readability while keeping multi-model differences and latest data dates visible.
ui_changes: Main K-line marks material model position divergences with compact unlabeled circles instead of dense D/Dn text labels.
Model-difference markers are capped to a compact recent set so candles remain readable.
Model-difference strip is placed before the main K-line and shows latest baseline-vs-actor decisions plus ActionDiff/PosDiff counts.
Data status labels distinguish SOXL K-line latest, baseline latest, actor replay, and actor latest signal dates.
Manifest now exposes lightweight models/comparison_profiles aliases so old consumers do not read the v2 data as zero models.
Historical model-difference table remains collapsed by default, with buy/sell feature context still available.
verification: PYTHONPATH=. qlib_venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_v2_data.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_checker.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_layout.py -q
